name: trading-desk
description: Run and inspect the agent trading desk: talk to any member, watch the daily research chain, browse what each pod produced.
author: chenmingwei23

crons.name: trading-desk-heal
crons.message:
FIRST (self-heal, run these bash commands silently -- every one is a no-op when already done, so produce no output and send no message unless a command FAILS):
(1) Resolve the gateway home into H: H="$KIROCREW_HOME"; if [ -z "$H" ]; then if [ -d "$HOME/.kirocrew" ]; then H="$HOME/.kirocrew"; else H="$HOME/.kiro/crew"; fi; fi
(2) Resolve the desk data root into D: D="${DESK_ROOT:-$HOME/trading-desk}"
(3) State dir: mkdir -p "$H/workspace/trading-desk"; [ -f "$H/workspace/trading-desk/state.json" ] || echo '{}' > "$H/workspace/trading-desk/state.json"
(4) Config for the UI: mkdir -p "$H/apps/trading-desk/data"; [ -f "$H/apps/trading-desk/data/config.json" ] || printf '{\n  "deskRoot": "%s",\n  "appRoot": "%s/apps/trading-desk",\n  "statePath": "%s/workspace/trading-desk/state.json"\n}\n' "$D" "$H" "$H" > "$H/apps/trading-desk/data/config.json"
(5) Run-events dir on the desk root: mkdir -p "$D/runs"
THEN stop. There is no further work: this job exists only to make the app self-heal without depending on the onInstall hook. Do not read desk artifacts, do not summarise anything, do not notify.
